messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: AMOVA
parts:
Hi J,

We are working in an AMOVA function to include different hierarchical levels. In the meantime, you could use the implementation in the package poppr:

library(poppr)
# Converting genlight to genind
geni <- gl2gi(bandicoot.gl)
# Assign pop information to strata
strata(geni) <- data.frame(pop = pop(geni))
# Performing AMOVA
amova_poppr <- poppr.amova(geni,~pop,nperm = 100)

Cheers,
Luis
